blocks.html: Just as importantly, our kitchen spraying process is carefully designed to give you confidence from start to finish. Rather than cutting corners, every stage is completed methodically, ensuring consistent results that genuinely last.

Thanks to meticulous preparation, specialist spraying equipment, and attention to detail, the finish looks factory-new rather than painted. Therefore, you get a premium result without the premium disruption.
How the Kitchen Spraying Process Works

items: Initial Consultation & Assessment: First, your kitchen is reviewed to confirm suitability and discuss colours, finishes, and expectations.
Careful Removal & Protection: Next, doors, drawers, and fittings are removed while surrounding areas are fully protected.
Deep Cleaning & Surface Preparation: Then, all surfaces are degreased, sanded, and repaired to ensure perfect paint adhesion.
Professional Spray Application: Using high-quality spray systems, coatings are applied evenly for a smooth, streak-free finish.
Controlled Drying & Curing: After spraying, units are allowed to cure properly, improving durability and lifespan.
Reinstallation & Final Checks: Finally, everything is refitted precisely, leaving your kitchen spotless and ready to use.

blocks.html: Because every step is managed professionally, you benefit from a seamless experience and a kitchen that looks exceptional for years.
